findings.title: Profit After Tax does not tie to Adjusted Profit After Tax
findings.detail: Actuals: EUR 178M on the cash flow vs EUR 176M on the P&L.
findings.prompt: Make Profit After Tax (cf-ni) equal to Adjusted Profit After Tax (ni) from the income statement instead of a separately planned input.

findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Lease Principal Payments & Share Buyback has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Financing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Lease Principal Payments & Share Buyback (cf-equity) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Financing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Cost of Sales % of Revenue
findings.detail: Cost of Sales has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Cost of Sales % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Add Operating Costs % of Revenue
findings.detail: Operating Costs has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Operating Costs % of Revenue" = opex-excl / rev * 100.

findings.title: Add Adjusted Profit Before Tax % of Revenue
findings.detail: Adjusted Profit Before Tax has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Adjusted Profit Before Tax % of Revenue" = ebt / rev * 100.

findings.title: Billed Revenue (Recurring Rental, CDR Usage & One-off) moved EUR -1.16B vs Budget
findings.detail: Largest Q3 Forecast vs Budget movement among P&L inputs.
findings.prompt: Explain the EUR -1.16B movement in Billed Revenue (Recurring Rental, CDR Usage & One-off) between Budget and Q3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
